failures.symptom: Supplier document authoring helper failed to parse before mutation.
failures.evidenceGap: Unwrapped authoring command; no measured run ID. Original error summarized with source preserved.
failures.cause: Markdown backticks were interpreted as JavaScript template delimiters.
failures.correction: Treat the literal document source as data; extract between exact markers without executing the invalid helper.

verification.reviewer: Codex root review of document and retained source

noFailuresReason: Editorial consolidation of existing evidence; no failed executions or new runtime defects observed.
